name: Navidrome
description: Serveur de musique compatible Subsonic, léger et rapide.
compose:
services:
  navidrome:
    image: deluan/navidrome:latest
    container_name: navidrome
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: "{{PUID}}:{{PGID}}"
    ports:
      - "4533:4533"
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/data:/data
      - {{DATA}}/Media/Music:/music:ro

en.description: Subsonic-compatible music server, light and fast.
